provenance.paper_title: Chain-of-Memory: Enhancing GUI Agents for Cross-Application Navigation

representation_paths.memory_component: recent operation descriptions and persistent task-relevant screen information

evidence.paraphrase: Information perception summarizes prior screens and actions; STM tracks recent task state and LTM preserves key screen information for action decisions.

At every step the model updates STM and decides which extracted screen facts should be added to persistent LTM. For Chain-of-Memory, this specifically supports LLM-mediated memory editing of recent operation descriptions and persistent task-relevant screen information.

During operation, Chain-of-Memory applies episodic or hierarchical summarization to recent operation descriptions and persistent task-relevant screen information; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

During operation, Chain-of-Memory applies explicit deletion or eviction of stored items to recent operation descriptions and persistent task-relevant screen information; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Both memory tiers are explicit textual records.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (recent operation descriptions and persistent task-relevant screen information) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, episodic or hierarchical summarization, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
